name: selavoice-mobile
description: Casco nativo (Android/iOS) do SelaVoice: abre https://selavoice.com/app (tela de entrar, nunca a landing). Quase tudo muda pelo site/painel, sem nova versão na loja.

scripts.prepare:android: cap add android && node scripts/patch-native.mjs android && capacitor-assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor #ffffff --splashBackgroundColor #ffffff && cap sync android
scripts.prepare:ios: cap add ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs ios && capacitor-assets generate --ios --iconBackgroundColor #ffffff --splashBackgroundColor #ffffff && cap sync ios
